answer_1.quote: Our framework consists of three main parts: First, we transform tables with varied structures into a unified multi-index data frame representation... Second, we translate TableQA questions into Python programs as an executable intermediate language by prompting code generation models...
answer_1.outputs: Python programs generated to answer TableQA questions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using the Execution Accuracy (EA) metric... EA measures the percentage of questions for which our method produces programs that yield correct answers.
